dataset_name: AVONET-derived bird trait table used by the fourth-corner GLLVM

source.licence: CC BY 4.0 as supplied by the author; retain the source attribution and licence statement with redistributed copies.
source.redistribution_status: confirm the exact AVONET release and document any author-side filtering or transformation

schema.record_unit: One taxon or species row as represented in the supplied trait table

model_fields.species1: Species name used to match trait rows to the species response matrix.
model_fields.mass: Body mass in grams; natural-log transformed, then centred and scaled for the fourth-corner model.
model_fields.hand_wing_index: Dimensionless hand-wing index; centred and scaled for the fourth-corner model.

fields.name: sequence
fields.definition: Row or sequence identifier from the source trait table.

fields.name: species1
fields.definition: Scientific name used as the trait-table matching key.

fields.name: family1
fields.definition: Family associated with species1.

fields.name: order1
fields.definition: Taxonomic order associated with species1.

fields.name: avibase_id1
fields.definition: Avibase identifier associated with species1.

fields.name: total_individuals
fields.definition: Number of individuals represented in the source measurements.

fields.name: female
fields.definition: Number of measured individuals recorded as female.

fields.name: male
fields.definition: Number of measured individuals recorded as male.

fields.name: unknown
fields.definition: Number of measured individuals with unknown or unreported sex.

fields.name: complete_measures
fields.definition: Source indicator or count describing completeness of the measured trait record; preserve source coding.

fields.name: beak_length_culmen
fields.definition: Bill length measured along the culmen.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: beak_length_nares
fields.definition: Bill length measured from the nares.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: beak_width
fields.definition: Bill width.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: beak_depth
fields.definition: Bill depth.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: tarsus_length
fields.definition: Tarsus length.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: wing_length
fields.definition: Wing length.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: kipps_distance
fields.definition: Kipp's distance, a measure of wing shape.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: secondary1
fields.definition: Source field for the secondary feather measurement or descriptor.

fields.name: hand_wing_index
fields.definition: Hand-wing index, a dimensionless measure derived from wing and Kipp's distance.

fields.name: tail_length
fields.definition: Tail length.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: mass
fields.definition: Body mass used as a fourth-corner predictor.

fields.name: mass_source
fields.definition: Source or method recorded for the mass value.

fields.name: mass_refs_other
fields.definition: Additional references associated with mass values.

fields.name: inference
fields.definition: Source field describing inference or imputation status; retain the source's coding.

fields.name: traits_inferred
fields.definition: Source flag or description indicating inferred trait values.

fields.name: reference_species
fields.definition: Reference taxon used when a value was inferred, where applicable.

fields.name: habitat
fields.definition: Source habitat category or descriptor.

fields.name: habitat_density
fields.definition: Source habitat-density category or descriptor.

fields.name: migration
fields.definition: Source migration category or descriptor.

fields.name: trophic_level
fields.definition: Source trophic-level category or value.

fields.name: trophic_niche
fields.definition: Source trophic-niche category or descriptor.

fields.name: primary_lifestyle
fields.definition: Source primary-lifestyle category or descriptor.

fields.name: min_latitude
fields.definition: Minimum latitude of the source species range.

fields.name: max_latitude
fields.definition: Maximum latitude of the source species range.

fields.name: centroid_latitude
fields.definition: Latitude of the source species-range centroid.

fields.name: centroid_longitude
fields.definition: Longitude of the source species-range centroid.

fields.name: range_size
fields.definition: Source estimate of geographic range size.
fields.unit: source-defined; confirm exact unit from the cited AVONET release

fields.name: species
fields.definition: Additional scientific-name field retained from the supplied table; not the model matching key.

transformations: The model matches taxa on species1.
The model uses mass and hand_wing_index; all other columns are retained source metadata unless otherwise noted.
The fitted model uses log(mass), then centres and scales it; hand_wing_index is centred and scaled.

author_confirmation_needed: Add the exact AVONET release citation and identifier.
Confirm units and source coding for fields marked source-defined.
Describe how this supplied subset was filtered or modified from the cited release.
